description: 八字/紫微 core_quality_human_review_bundle 提交前演练模板契约。该契约只生成可填写骨架、hash 计算说明、no-leak checklist 和 operator checklist；模板本身不能作为真实专家评审、外部 benchmark 或 no-leak signoff 证据。

hashPolicy.artifactBoundary: Only hash redacted artifacts after reviewer and benchmark no-leak checks.

noLeakPolicy.rawEndpointPolicy: Do not place raw public endpoints, account identifiers, production paths or credentials in the bundle.

releaseBoundary: 该模板只证明提交前材料结构、hash 说明和 no-leak 检查清单已准备；不证明专家评审完成、外部 benchmark 通过、no-leak signoff 已签署、八字/紫微专业能力 100% 或 FateCat 可声明 100% 测算基础设施。
nonClaims: Does not mean professional review is complete.
Does not mean external benchmark is accepted.
Does not mean no-leak signoff is accepted.
Does not mean bazi/ziwei professional quality is 100% proven.
Does not mean FateCat can claim 100% measurement infrastructure.
Does not store reviewer identity, real user birth data, benchmark item details or report body.
